props.name: current
props.description: Seats currently paid for. The change is measured from here.

props.name: inUse
props.description: Seats occupied by members. The count cannot go below this.

props.name: value
props.description: The seat count being chosen. Omit to let the component manage it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting count when uncontrolled. Defaults to `current`.

props.name: pricePerSeat
props.description: Price of one seat on each cycle.

props.name: cycle
props.description: Billing cycle whose price applies. Omit to let the component manage it.

props.name: periodEnd
props.description: When the current billing period ends — the next invoice date.

props.name: periodStart
props.description: When it began. Defaults to one cycle before `periodEnd`.

props.name: max
props.description: The upper bound, for plans with a seat cap.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called with the new count. A promise shows the pending state.
